G5 SAF Average Week 1-2
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- G5 Safety Season Averages (Week 1-2) ---

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read the CSV files
# Week 1
s_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 1/G5/G5 Safety Week 1 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 2
s_week2 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 2/G5/G5 Safety Week 2 Grade 2024.csv")

# Combine the data
s_combined <- bind_rows(
  s_week1 %>% mutate(Week = 1),
  s_week2 %>% mutate(Week = 2)
)

# Calculate averages by player
s_season_avg <- s_combined %>%
  group_by(Name, Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Snaps = sum(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Snaps_Per_Game = mean(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Composite_Score = mean(Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Games_Played = n_distinct(Week),
    Max_Snaps_In_Game = max(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Avg_Composite_Score)) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of games (1 out of 2 weeks)
  filter(Games_Played >= 1) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of their max snaps
  filter(Avg_Snaps_Per_Game >= 0.5 * Max_Snaps_In_Game) %>%
  
  # Determine quartile for adjustment
  mutate(
    Score_Quartile = ntile(Avg_Composite_Score, 4),
    
    # Apply quartile adjustment
    Quartile_Adjustment = case_when(
      Score_Quartile == 4 ~ 1.12,   # top boost still strong
      Score_Quartile == 3 ~ 1.05,   # moderate
      Score_Quartile == 2 ~ 0.98,   # small downward tug
      Score_Quartile == 1 ~ 0.85,   # still punishes bottom
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    
    # Apply quartile adjustment to the average score before curving
    Adjusted_Avg_Score = Avg_Composite_Score * Quartile_Adjustment,
    
    # Curved / smoothed score (now applied to adjusted average)
    Adjusted_Score = pmin(round(100 * (Adjusted_Avg_Score / 100)^0.7, 2), 100),
    
    Display_Grade = case_when(
      Adjusted_Score >= 93.333 ~ "A+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 86.667 ~ "A",
      Adjusted_Score >= 80 ~ "A-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 73.333 ~ "B+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 66.667 ~ "B",
      Adjusted_Score >= 60 ~ "B-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 53.333 ~ "C+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 46.667 ~ "C",
      Adjusted_Score >= 40 ~ "C-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 33.333 ~ "D+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 26.667 ~ "D",
      Adjusted_Score >= 20 ~ "D-",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Adjusted_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Total_Snaps, Avg_Snaps_Per_Game, Games_Played, Adjusted_Score, Display_Grade)

# View results
print(s_season_avg)
View(s_season_avg)

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Safeties evaluated:", nrow(s_season_avg), "\n")
cat("Average Adjusted Score:", round(mean(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Adjusted Score:", max(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Adjusted Score:", min(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")

# Grade distribution
cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(s_season_avg$Display_Grade))

# Top 10 Safeties
cat("\n=== TOP 10 Safeties ===\n")
print(head(s_season_avg, 10))

# --- Save the file ---
write.csv(
  s_season_avg,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 2/G5/Season Averages/G5 Safety Average Week 1-2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILE SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("Location: /Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 2/G5/Season Averages/G5 Safety Average Week 1-2.csv\n")

```

s_week2 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 2/G5/G5 Safety Week 2 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 3
s_week3 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 3/G5/G5 Safety Week 3 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 4
s_week4 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 4/G5/G5 Safety Week 4 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 5
s_week5 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 5/G5/G5 Safety Week 5 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 6
s_week6 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 6/G5/G5 Safety Week 6 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 7
s_week7 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 7/G5/G5 Safety Week 7 Grade 2024.csv")

# Combine the data
s_combined <- bind_rows(
  s_week1 %>% mutate(Week = 1),
  s_week2 %>% mutate(Week = 2),
  s_week3 %>% mutate(Week = 3),
  s_week4 %>% mutate(Week = 4),
  s_week5 %>% mutate(Week = 5),
  s_week6 %>% mutate(Week = 6),
  s_week7 %>% mutate(Week = 7)
)

# Calculate averages by player
s_season_avg <- s_combined %>%
  group_by(Name, Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Snaps = sum(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Snaps_Per_Game = mean(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Composite_Score = mean(Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Games_Played = n_distinct(Week),
    Max_Snaps_In_Game = max(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Avg_Composite_Score)) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of games (4 out of 7 weeks)
  filter(Games_Played >= 4) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of their max snaps
  filter(Avg_Snaps_Per_Game >= 0.5 * Max_Snaps_In_Game) %>%
  
  # Determine quartile for adjustment
  mutate(
    Score_Quartile = ntile(Avg_Composite_Score, 4),
    
    # Apply quartile adjustment
    Quartile_Adjustment = case_when(
      Score_Quartile == 4 ~ 1.12,   # top boost still strong
      Score_Quartile == 3 ~ 1.05,   # moderate
      Score_Quartile == 2 ~ 0.98,   # small downward tug
      Score_Quartile == 1 ~ 0.85,   # still punishes bottom
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    
    # Apply quartile adjustment to the average score before curving
    Adjusted_Avg_Score = Avg_Composite_Score * Quartile_Adjustment,
    
    # Curved / smoothed score (now applied to adjusted average)
    Adjusted_Score = pmin(round(100 * (Adjusted_Avg_Score / 100)^0.7, 2), 100),
    
    Display_Grade = case_when(
      Adjusted_Score >= 93.333 ~ "A+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 86.667 ~ "A",
      Adjusted_Score >= 80 ~ "A-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 73.333 ~ "B+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 66.667 ~ "B",
      Adjusted_Score >= 60 ~ "B-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 53.333 ~ "C+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 46.667 ~ "C",
      Adjusted_Score >= 40 ~ "C-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 33.333 ~ "D+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 26.667 ~ "D",
      Adjusted_Score >= 20 ~ "D-",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Adjusted_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Total_Snaps, Avg_Snaps_Per_Game, Games_Played, Adjusted_Score, Display_Grade)

# View results
print(s_season_avg)
View(s_season_avg)

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Safeties evaluated:", nrow(s_season_avg), "\n")
cat("Average Adjusted Score:", round(mean(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Adjusted Score:", max(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Adjusted Score:", min(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")

# Grade distribution
cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(s_season_avg$Display_Grade))

# Top 10 Safeties
cat("\n=== TOP 10 Safeties ===\n")
print(head(s_season_avg, 10))

# --- Save the file ---
write.csv(
  s_season_avg,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 7/G5/Season Averages/G5 Safety Average Week 1-7.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Week 7

# Week 8
s_week8 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 8/G5/G5 Safety Week 8 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 9
s_week9 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 9/G5/G5 Safety Week 9 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 10
s_week10 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 10/G5/G5 Safety Week 10 Grade 2024.csv")
# Week 11
s_week11 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 11/G5/G5 Safety Week 11 Grade 2024.csv")

# Combine the data
s_combined <- bind_rows(
  s_week1 %>% mutate(Week = 1),
  s_week2 %>% mutate(Week = 2),
  s_week3 %>% mutate(Week = 3),

  s_week5 %>% mutate(Week = 5),
  s_week6 %>% mutate(Week = 6),

# Calculate averages by player
s_season_avg <- s_combined %>%
  group_by(Name, Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Snaps = sum(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Snaps_Per_Game = mean(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Composite_Score = mean(Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Games_Played = n_distinct(Week),
    Max_Snaps_In_Game = max(Defensive.Snaps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Avg_Composite_Score)) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of games (6 out of 11 weeks)
  filter(Games_Played >= 6) %>%
  
  # Filter for players who played at least 50% of their max snaps
  filter(Avg_Snaps_Per_Game >= 0.5 * Max_Snaps_In_Game) %>%
  
  # Determine quartile for adjustment
  mutate(
    Score_Quartile = ntile(Avg_Composite_Score, 4),

      Score_Quartile == 4 ~ 1.12,   # top boost still strong
      Score_Quartile == 3 ~ 1.05,   # moderate
      Score_Quartile == 2 ~ 0.98,   # small downward tug
      Score_Quartile == 1 ~ 0.85,   # still punishes bottom
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    
    # Apply quartile adjustment to the average score before curving
    Adjusted_Avg_Score = Avg_Composite_Score * Quartile_Adjustment,
    
    # Curved / smoothed score (now applied to adjusted average)
    Adjusted_Score = pmin(round(100 * (Adjusted_Avg_Score / 100)^0.7, 2), 100),
    
    Display_Grade = case_when(
      Adjusted_Score >= 93.333 ~ "A+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 86.667 ~ "A",
      Adjusted_Score >= 80 ~ "A-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 73.333 ~ "B+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 66.667 ~ "B",
      Adjusted_Score >= 60 ~ "B-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 53.333 ~ "C+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 46.667 ~ "C",
      Adjusted_Score >= 40 ~ "C-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 33.333 ~ "D+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 26.667 ~ "D",
      Adjusted_Score >= 20 ~ "D-",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Adjusted_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Total_Snaps, Avg_Snaps_Per_Game, Games_Played, Adjusted_Score, Display_Grade)

# View results

cat("Total Safeties evaluated:", nrow(s_season_avg), "\n")

    Adjusted_Avg_Score = Avg_Composite_Score * Quartile_Adjustment,
    
    # Curved / smoothed score (now applied to adjusted average)
    Adjusted_Score = pmin(round(100 * (Adjusted_Avg_Score / 100)^0.7, 2), 100),
    
    Display_Grade = case_when(
      Adjusted_Score >= 93.333 ~ "A+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 86.667 ~ "A",
      Adjusted_Score >= 80 ~ "A-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 73.333 ~ "B+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 66.667 ~ "B",
      Adjusted_Score >= 60 ~ "B-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 53.333 ~ "C+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 46.667 ~ "C",
      Adjusted_Score >= 40 ~ "C-",
      Adjusted_Score >= 33.333 ~ "D+",
      Adjusted_Score >= 26.667 ~ "D",
      Adjusted_Score >= 20 ~ "D-",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Adjusted_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Total_Snaps, Avg_Snaps_Per_Game, Games_Played, Adjusted_Score, Display_Grade)

# View results
print(s_season_avg)
View(s_season_avg)

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Safeties evaluated:", nrow(s_season_avg), "\n")
cat("Average Adjusted Score:", round(mean(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Adjusted Score:", max(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Adjusted Score:", min(s_season_avg$Adjusted_Score), "\n")

# Grade distribution
cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(s_season_avg$Display_Grade))

# Top 10 Safeties
cat("\n=== TOP 10 Safeties ===\n")
print(head(s_season_avg, 10))

# --- Save the file ---
write.csv(

  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 14/G5/Season Averages/G5 Safety Average Week 1-14.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
